title: Path capture plan
description: One browser session and an ordered list of steps: a path through a UI, with a picture taken at the points a reader needs to see. Validated by lib/plan.mjs before a browser opens, so a mistyped key is an error rather than a step that silently does nothing.

tutorial.description: Name of the walkthrough. Becomes the default run directory name and the review sheet's title.

description.description: What this path proves, in one or two sentences.

instance.description: Which deployment the plan runs against (dev, staging, a local stack).

baseUrl.description: Absolute URL for relative `goto` values, or a `${VAR}` placeholder so one plan serves several environments.

locale.description: Browser locale and Accept-Language. A page that renders in another language fails the run.

colorScheme.description: Pinned theme. When dark, a page that paints a light background fails the run instead of shipping a figure mid-theme.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Capture ratio. 2 is the practical minimum for a figure a reader may zoom into; 4 survives a 2x display without resampling.

pad.description: Pixels kept around a trimmed frame (default 32).

themeStorage.description: One storage key pinned before any script runs, for state a site applies after first paint: a theme it reads from storage rather than prefers-color-scheme ({"cp-theme": "dark"}), or a dismissal flag that hides chrome the site would otherwise paint and then remove.

reducedMotion.description: prefers-reduced-motion. A recorded video forces no-preference: an app with every transition switched off records as a series of stills.

vars.description: Values interpolated as ${name}. Prefer `literal` with neutral data for anything a figure will show; use `env` for credentials.

env.description: Environment variable to read (defaults to the var's own name).

literal.description: A value fixed in the plan.

steps.description: Executed in order. Actions inside one step run in a fixed order, so `fill` + `expect` + `shot` in one step is one screen from top to bottom.

name.description: What this step does, shown in logs and evidence files.

caption.description: The subtitle for this step: drawn in the page for the step's whole duration and written beside the recording as a WebVTT file. One line, a sentence a viewer reads while watching — an empty or over-long caption is refused.

check.description: The checklist item this step ticks, drawn in a panel beside the recording the moment the step starts. The panel's rows are derived from the steps in first-appearance order, so this key is the only place the list is written; a repeated text is one row.

when.description: Skip the step unless the page matches. A plan cannot branch, and a third-party flow looks different on the first run than on the tenth.

url.description: Regular expression tested against the current URL.

text.description: Text that must be on screen (whitespace-insensitive).

goto.description: A path relative to baseUrl, or an absolute URL.

fill.description: Set a field in one assignment. Some frameworks ignore it; use `type` there.

type.description: Send real key events, one character at a time, for a form that only enables its button after typing.

click.description: Click a selector that must exist.

clickIfPresent.description: Click if it appears. For a cookie banner that some regions get and others do not — absence is not a failure.

clickNewPage.description: Click something with target=_blank; the rest of the plan continues in the new tab.

pause.description: Milliseconds to wait, for a page that settles on its own timer.

hold.description: Milliseconds of stillness after this step's actions, before the next step starts — a beat a viewer can read. Only meaningful in a humanized run.

setVar.description: Read a value off the page into ${name} — a password an installer generates and shows once. Written to .vars.json (mode 600), never logged.

text.description: Text that must appear in body.innerText, whitespace-insensitive.

url.description: URL pattern(s) to wait for; an array accepts either outcome.

waitFor.description: Wait until the page is somewhere worth photographing.

waitHidden.description: Wait until chrome is gone: a control the server rendered visible and the page's own script hides on boot.

mask.description: Locators painted over before the shot. Prefer a neutral literal value — a black rectangle reads as a mistake.

expect.description: What this screen must prove, checked before the shot. Page text (string or array), or { "selector": "#login-form" } for elements that must be visible. Guard the ids the path depends on; reserve text for words the document makes a claim about.

shot.description: Take the picture. A bare string is the figure id.

id.description: Figure id; also the file name (<id>.png). Unique within a plan.

oneOf.description: Selector whose bounding box is the subject.
A measured rect in CSS pixels, for a subject with no element of its own. Carries its own padding.

pad.description: Breathing room around a selector clip or a trimmed frame (default 32). Raise it for a dense card or one with a shadow.

holdMs.description: How long the video holds this frame before the next action (default: humanize.shotHoldMs, 1200).

video.description: How the recording is drawn, rather than what the walkthrough does. Drawable only in a humanized run: the panel is an overlay in the page.

checklist.description: The appearance of the checklist panel. The items are the steps that carry a `check` — there is no list to write here.

title.description: The heading above the rows. An empty string hides it.

side.description: Which edge the panel is docked to. Pick the side the app leaves empty.

width.description: Panel width in CSS pixels, capped at 30% of the viewport. Narrower rows than 220 crowd the labels; wider than 380 the panel covers the app.

accent.description: Colour of a completed tick: #rgb or #rrggbb.

humanize.description: How the page is driven: pointer, curved travel, hover dwell, typing cadence. On by default for --video, off otherwise. Everything is sampled from `seed`, so the same seed replays the same path.

seed.description: The same seed replays the same path, typing rhythm and scheduled delays. --seed overrides.

speed.description: Divides every delay: 1 is a natural pace, 20 a fast test run. --speed overrides.

moveMs.description: Travel duration range in ms, interpolated by distance (default [220, 640]).

dwellMs.description: Hover on the target before the press (default [80, 220]).

pressMs.description: How long the button is held down (default [60, 120]).

maxChars.description: Above this length a value is typed at the start and pasted (default 40).

shotHoldMs.description: How long a figure's frame is held in the video.

loadMs.description: Wait after a navigation, before the page is trusted to hold still.

loadFade.description: Fade up from maskColor between pages, instead of a white flash.
